what: F1 Proposed wrapper can emit EMIT_BODY=true even when write-final-report.sh fails
scenario_or_breakage: Current Step 18 only allows the top-chat body emit after write-final-report.sh succeeds and summary-final.md is non-empty; the proposed wrapper initializes emit_body from .step17-emitted before WFR_RC, so an absent sentinel plus WFR failure can tell the orchestrator to emit stale or nonexistent summary content
suggested_fix: Set EMIT_BODY=false unless WFR_RC=0 and summary-final.md is non-empty; add a wrapper harness case where write-final-report.sh fails with .step17-emitted absent and EMIT_BODY=false

what: F2 Existing write-final-report harness would keep pinning the retired inline Step 18 --print-stdout contract
scenario_or_breakage: The plan moves Step 18 emit decision into step-18b-final-report.sh and intentionally drops --print-stdout, but the existing harness and sibling doc still describe Step 18 conditional --print-stdout mirroring; leaving them unchanged creates contradictory coverage that can pass while no longer testing the live Step 18 path
suggested_fix: Move the Step 18 emit matrix to test-step-18b-final-report.sh and retitle or trim the old cases/docs so test-write-final-report only covers write-final-report.sh interface behavior

what: F3 Planned clear-stall tests do not cover the append-when-absent state-key contract
scenario_or_breakage: Step 7 requires the success clear to leave durable STALL_TRACKING=false and STALL_STEP=, and teardown later requires STALL_TRACKING to exist; if the new awk rewrite only updates existing keys, a session-layer stall with a partial ship-pr-state.sh can pass the proposed happy-path tests but still fail teardown validation
suggested_fix: Add one minimal clear-stall fixture with an existing state file missing STALL_TRACKING and STALL_STEP, asserting CLEARED=true plus appended STALL_TRACKING=false and STALL_STEP= while preserving unrelated keys
